activity_summary: After Errors you reckoned the afternoon with John, Margery, and Kemp. The house had been thin. Margery named no sum. John said he would not set a figure and would not borrow one. Kemp had done the jig and did not ask for a number. You added nothing, and you opened no second matter. Nobody spoke of the morning's play.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Left the blank as a blank, and opened no second matter.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Refused a figure and entered the thin house without a number.

entities.name: Goodwife Margery Pell
entities.context: Called it thin and would not supply a sum.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Kept the jig, and did not ask what the morning had been.

entities.name: Errors
entities.context: Mentioned in No figure for the afternoon

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: I am not setting a figure on this afternoon, and I will not borrow one.

quotes.speaker: margery_pell
quotes.text: Thin. Errors, and they listened, and I am still not putting a sum in anyone's mouth.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: There is no figure, and there is no second matter.
